changelog:
- Operates Placid through the OOMOL `oo` CLI using server-side managed credentials.
- Supports listing and inspecting Placid templates, including dynamic layer metadata for image generation.
- Queues image generation from template UUIDs and dynamic layer payloads.
- Polls generated image status and returns finished image URLs when available.
- Includes guarded destructive support for deleting Placid image requests.
